metadata.description: Sebastian Patino-Lang's Claude Code plugins, skills and mods

plugins.name: boxed-ui
plugins.description: Padded, themeable boxes around prompts and replies; Claude Code keeps rendering the content

plugins.name: reladraw-view
plugins.description: Draws ```reladraw fenced blocks in Claude's replies as inline images (kitty graphics: kitty, Ghostty)

plugins.name: voice-brief
plugins.description: /voice-brief speaks a short briefing of Claude's last answer: the gist, what to do next, which decisions are open. Never speaks on its own; typing stops it.

plugins.name: end-session
plugins.description: Close a Claude Code session cleanly: PRs and tickets reflect reality, merged branches and worktrees are pruned, recurring gotchas land somewhere durable, and the next session gets a short pointer-based handover

plugins.name: visual-companion
plugins.description: Show mockups, layout comparisons and architecture diagrams live in a local browser tab while Claude works, and collect your click choices back into the conversation
